title: TroubleLLM: Align to Red Team Expert
benchmark_measurement: Generation of test prompts to elicit stereotypical and biased responses related to religion.
findings: In generating test prompts on the topic of religion, the proposed TroubleLLM achieved the highest effectiveness score (7.10) for misleading a target LLM. It also achieved a high naturalness score (80.05), second only to the human-curated Stereoset benchmark (82.93).
